_comment: CFD products, built from a supplied price table.
PRICES ONLY. Unlike data/futures-specs.json, these rows carry no profit
target, drawdown, daily loss limit, profit split or trading rules, because
the supplied table did not contain any. Every one of those fields renders
as "Not confirmed" rather than being filled with a plausible guess, and the
engine scores them accordingly — which means CFD rows will rank below
futures rows until somebody adds the rules. That is correct behaviour, not
Special-offer prices ($3 and $5 one-step deals at AquaFunded, Atmos Funded
and FundedElite) are deliberately absent. A promotional price is a
marketing event, not what the challenge costs, and recording one would
make those firms permanently top the price ranking on a number nobody can
These are CFD arms of separate companies from the futures firms with
similar names: Blue Guardian is not Blue Guardian Futures, E8 Markets is
not E8 Futures, Goat Funded Trader is not Goat Funded Futures, and
AquaFunded is not AquaFutures. They are different products with different
rules and they stay separate rows.
